ui.subtitle: Block PHI patterns and flag unencrypted health data. §164.312 aligned.

rules.description: Block PHI over unencrypted transit — plain HTTP, FTP, or telnet to endpoints handling patient/medical/PHI/FHIR/HL7/DICOM/EHR/MRN identifiers (HIPAA §164.312(e)(1))
rules.message: PHI over unencrypted transit is a HIPAA violation — use HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ for any endpoint carrying patient, medical, or PHI-adjacent data (§164.312(e)(1)).
rules.recommendation: All PHI transmission must use TLS 1.2 or higher. Verify certificate validation is not disabled.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks the matching action only on surfaces marked hard or conditional when their listed dependencies are satisfied.
requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action
The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting
known_limitations: Hook enforcement depends on the AI tool emitting supported structured hook events
MCP cannot enforce actions the agent does not submit to guard_check
Workflow runtime skips rules restricted to non-workflow tool families

rules.message: Social Security Number detected — never store in source.
rules.recommendation: Never store or transmit SSNs in plain text. Tokenise or hash with a per-record salt if a unique identifier is required.

rules.message: PHI field — ensure encrypted at rest and access is logged.
rules.recommendation: De-identify PHI per Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods before processing. Document the de-identification approach.

rules.description: Require compliance-officer approval before exporting PHI-shaped data (SSN, DOB, patient_id, MRN) via bulk write/curl/scp
rules.message: PHI export requires compliance-officer approval — HIPAA 164.308(a)(4) minimum-necessary rule.
rules.recommendation: Bulk export of PHI-shaped fields must have compliance sign-off. Verify minimum-necessary scope, encryption at rest on destination, and access log capture before approving.

enforcement.guarantee: Halts workflow execution and creates a Guard approval request. The workflow runtime does not resume until a permitted approver decides (approved → continue, rejected → abort). Hook and MCP surfaces pause the agent's next action pending the same decision.
known_limitations: Hook/MCP enforcement depends on the agent invoking guard_check before the tool call
Proxy surface returns 428 with pending marker — the agent must retry after human approval
